title: Collaborative Spreadsheet with a Formula Dependency Graph
description: Builds a browser spreadsheet where cells hold formulas, recalculating only the cells affected by an edit through a dependency graph and detecting circular references before they freeze the page.

title: Client-Side Search Index for Static Sites
description: Generates an inverted index at build time and searches it in the browser with ranking and prefix matching, so a documentation site gets search without any server.

title: Feature Flag Service with Percentage Rollouts
description: Serves feature flags to client apps with targeting rules and gradual percentage rollouts that keep each user in a stable bucket, and records which flag state each request saw.

title: API Gateway with Keys, Quotas and Usage Metering
description: Fronts a small API with key issuing, per-key rate limits and monthly quotas, and shows each customer their usage in a dashboard built from the same metering data.

title: Webhook Delivery Service with Retries and Signatures
description: Delivers event notifications to subscriber URLs with signed payloads, exponential backoff retries, a dead-letter queue and a log showing every attempt and response.

title: Offline-Capable Textbook Reader as a Progressive Web App
description: Lets students download chapters for offline reading, keeps notes and highlights in local storage, and syncs them when the connection returns without losing edits.

title: Live Election Results Dashboard with Server-Sent Events
description: Streams constituency results to thousands of viewers using server-sent events, with charts that update smoothly and a replay mode for reviewing how the count evolved.

title: GraphQL API for a Library Catalogue with Batched Loading
description: Exposes books, authors and loans through a GraphQL schema and uses batching to avoid the N+1 query problem, showing query counts before and after.

title: OAuth Sign-In Integration with Secure Session Handling
description: Adds sign-in with an external identity provider using the authorisation code flow with PKCE, and secures the resulting session with careful cookie settings and logout handling.

title: Markdown Resume Builder with Print Stylesheets
description: Turns a Markdown file into a clean, printable resume with selectable themes, so layout is controlled entirely with CSS and prints correctly to A4 and Letter.

title: CSS Grid and Flexbox Playground for Learners
description: Provides an interactive page where changing layout properties updates a live preview and shows the generated CSS, with guided challenges that check the learner's result.

title: Browser Image Editor with Canvas Filters
description: Edits images entirely in the browser with crop, rotate, brightness and convolution filters on a canvas, with undo history and exports that never leave the device.

title: In-Browser SQL Playground with Guided Exercises
description: Runs SQLite compiled to WebAssembly in the page so learners can practise queries against sample databases, with exercises that compare their result sets with the expected ones.

title: Localised Storefront with Locale Formatting and Right-to-Left Layout
description: Builds a storefront that switches language, currency, date and number formats at runtime and mirrors its layout correctly for right-to-left languages.

title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Starter with Row-Level Isolation
description: Hosts many customer organisations in one database with row-level security policies, and proves with automated tests that one tenant can never read or write another's data.

title: Link Preview Service with Server-Side Request Forgery Defences
description: Fetches titles and images for pasted links while blocking requests to internal addresses, redirects to private ranges and oversized responses, with tests that attempt each attack.

title: Web Components Design System Library
description: Publishes a small set of accessible buttons, dialogs and form controls as framework-independent web components with documented tokens and keyboard behaviour.

title: Windowed Infinite List for Large Datasets
description: Renders a list of hundreds of thousands of rows by drawing only the visible slice, handling variable row heights and scroll restoration, and measures the memory saved.

title: Quiz Show Host with WebSocket Lobbies
description: Runs live multiplayer quizzes where a host creates a lobby, players join with a code and answers are scored by speed and correctness, with reconnection handling for dropped players.

title: Personal Knowledge Wiki with Backlinks
description: Stores linked notes in Markdown, detects references between them to show backlinks and a graph view, and offers full-text search across every note.

title: Typing Practice with Keystroke Analytics
description: Measures typing speed and accuracy as a user types, and breaks the results down by key and finger to show which letters cause the most errors over time.

title: Recipe Scaler and Unit Converter
description: Scales ingredient quantities to a chosen number of servings and converts between metric and imperial units, rounding sensibly to measures a cook can actually use.

title: Responsive HTML Email Template Builder
description: Builds email templates from reusable blocks that render consistently across mail clients by generating table-based markup with inlined styles, and previews them at several widths.

title: Social Card Image Generator Service
description: Generates preview images for shared pages from a template and page metadata on demand, caching results so repeated shares are served instantly.

title: Website Performance Budget Monitor
description: Runs automated performance audits against pages on every change and fails a build when load time, script size or layout shift exceed agreed budgets, charting the trend.

title: Idempotent Payments API Simulation
description: Implements a payments endpoint that stays correct when clients retry, using idempotency keys and a state machine, and tests duplicate requests and mid-request failures.

title: Search Box with Debounce, Caching and Keyboard Navigation
description: Builds a type-ahead search box that waits for the user to pause, caches earlier results and supports full keyboard control with accessible announcements.

title: Web Push Notification Service
description: Lets users subscribe to browser notifications, stores their subscriptions and sends targeted messages with delivery tracking, while handling expired subscriptions cleanly.

title: Event-Sourced Order Tracking Backend
description: Stores every change to an order as an immutable event and rebuilds current state and history from the event log, with projections that power a customer tracking page.

title: Cookie Consent Manager with Auditable Preferences
description: Collects visitors' cookie choices, only loads optional scripts after consent and keeps a timestamped record of each decision that can be shown on request.

title: Shared Reading List with Link Archiving
description: Lets a group save articles to a shared list with tags and notes, and stores a readable copy of each page so links keep working after the original disappears.

title: Status Page and Uptime Checker
description: Probes a list of endpoints on a schedule, records response times, opens and closes incidents automatically and publishes a public page showing current status and past uptime.
